name: Human
description: Resourceful, skillful, and versatile innovators found across the multiverse.

name: Elf
description: As an Elf, you have supernatural traits derived from your ancient lineage, keen senses, darkvision, and a trancelike meditation routine.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: Proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need sleep and can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours.

lineages.name: Drow
lineages.description: Darkvision increases to 120 ft. You know Dancing Lights (Lvl 1), Faerie Fire (Lvl 3), and Darkness (Lvl 5).

lineages.name: High Elf
lineages.description: You know Prestidigitation (replaceable on Long Rest), Detect Magic (Lvl 3), and Misty Step (Lvl 5).

lineages.name: Wood Elf
lineages.description: Speed increases to 35 ft. You know Druidcraft (Lvl 1), Longstrider (Lvl 3), and Pass without Trace (Lvl 5).
